description: Labelled India-focused evaluation dataset (English + Hinglish + Devanagari text, plus an OCR channel where `image_lines` is rendered to PNG and read by the production OCR path). label=scam samples must be detected; label=safe samples are hard negatives and must not be flagged. expected_verdict is the exact verdict the deterministic policy must produce.
